description: Traditional elegance meets modern functionality in the West Lake Crib. Handcrafted from solid hardwood with a warm Brown Maple finish, this 4-in-1 convertible crib features graceful raised panel detailing and decorative leg cuts that add timeless character to your nursery. Convert from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed as your family grows, making this a lasting investment in your child's comfort. Three adjustable mattress positions keep your baby safe at every stage. Finished with non-toxic, baby-safe materials that meet or exceed all CPSC and ASTM standards. Coordinates with the full West Lake collection of dressers, chests, nightstands, and accessories for a complete, cohesive nursery.
